findings.evidence: The deterministic audit reports frontage_ratio=0.2916667, solid_void_frontage_ratio=0.4014085, 85 unbounded route sides, 91 through-core sightlines, max_sightline_m=42.75, and overhead_route_ratio=0.2553191. The eye-level images visibly open onto lawn or horizon.
findings.invariant: The exterior route must be the compact continuous void left between occupied masses, with no through-core chord and 45-65% meaningful overhead cover.

findings.evidence: All seven stair nodes have exact two-lane endpoint seams and one connected exterior component, but level_changing_loop_count remains 0 and max_constant_elevation_run_m is 14.8057 against the 12 m limit.
findings.invariant: The route must include a level-changing reconnecting loop and cannot rely on one long primary chain as its only traversal choice.

findings.evidence: The fixed harness still represents surveyed terrain perches with stacked rectangular rock cells and exposed green tops. They are aligned mathematically but read as artificial ledges and towers in several views.
findings.invariant: Final visual review must use the exact runtime terrain payload or a pinned equivalent; a block proxy cannot establish the quality of building-to-terrain alignment.

findings.evidence: All 20 camera positions are collision-clear and 19 target rays pass. The sectional profile is retained as useful overview evidence but is explicitly classified target-obscured.
findings.invariant: A closing review requires every named target to be visible from a collision-clear exterior camera.
